title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Final code review for #2. I read the full diff against the Definition of done, `AGENTS.md` and `.cursor/rules`.

Definition of done:
- All 12 event types and the 6 node types are exported from `@rewind/shared` through `src/index.ts`, with TSDoc. Done.
- `parseEvent` validates every event type, returns `{ ok: false, error: { path, message } }` for bad input, and never throws (null, primitives, random objects, cycles, deep trees, throwing getters are tested). Done.
- `createEvent` gives a strictly increasing `seq` per clock, including 1000 events in the same millisecond. Done.
- Narrowing on `event.type` is proven with `expectTypeOf`. Done.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` has the Session format section and an example that is tested. Done.
- Lint, typecheck, test and build are green on `09f0a79`. Done.

Rules:
- Every part has a `test(...)` commit before its implementation commit. No test was weakened.
- No `any`, named exports only, no new runtime dependency (hand-written guards, ADR 0006).
- The `tsup.config.ts` change in `recorder` and `player` is outside the issue scope. It is needed so the DTS build passes, and the PR explains why. Accepted.
- ADRs 0004 to 0009 record the decisions a reviewer might question.
- The PR is larger than the 800-line guideline (about 3600 lines, about half of it tests). That comes from the size of the issue, not from scope creep. Noted for planning, not blocking.

No user-visible change, so `qa/product.md` needs no update. QA starts now: the smoke check on desktop and mobile.
